items.title: PRO doubles podium at HYROX Birmingham
items.summary: Adam Corlett and Lewis Overend took second in the PRO Doubles Men 35-39 at HYROX Birmingham in 51:21 — with a 51:36 doubles alongside Alex MacDonald the same weekend.
items.take: Two doubles races, one weekend, one podium. The engine never really stops.

items.title: HYROX London ExCeL lands 2–6 December
items.summary: The biggest HYROX on the calendar returns to ExCeL London across five race days — the next big target on the ACE timeline.
items.take: Five days of racing on the biggest floor in the sport — the perfect first HYROX or the perfect PB.

items.title: 5th at the World Championships
items.summary: Adam finished 5th in the world at HYROX World Championships 2026 in Stockholm (1:00:14 PRO) — defending his crown 'in the shape of my life'.
items.take: Fifth on the planet. And he coaches everyday athletes on weekday evenings — that mix is the whole point of this gym.
